evals.prompt: Add a new 'saved-view' module: users can save a named set of trace filters per project, list them and delete them. Settings page under the project.
evals.expected_output: Creates modules/saved-view/{contract,server,web} with feature.json, a spec file written first, a catalogue.json subject, zod schemas with infer, a callable <Name>Api interface with its moduleApi token, an installer built with defineModule, an app class over private services, repository interfaces with Prisma and memory backends selected by defineRepositories, a flat tRPC declaration via defineTrpcContract in the contract and defineTrpcRouter / defineRestRouter, an apps/api composition that boots the installer with createApp, apps/ui catalogue and WebInstallation registrations, error codes registered in handled-error, and tests binding every scenario; runs scoped gates only.

evals.prompt: Scaffold a module for webhook signing keys, server only, no UI yet.
evals.expected_output: Creates contract and server only, no web package, names the absence of a UI, and still writes the spec, the API token, the installer, the app, the service, both repository backends, the transport declaration and the composition.

evals.prompt: In the secret module, add the ability to rotate a secret's value and record who rotated it.
evals.expected_output: Adds a tagged scenario first, an input schema and the operation on the SecretApi in contract, the operation on the app and its service, a repository method carrying projectId on the interface and on both the Prisma and memory backends, an inline tRPC handler on the flat declaration, the api-map entry and a hook in web, an error code if a failure is named, and binds tests at each layer; does not touch other modules' packages.

evals.prompt: Prompts should refuse a version note longer than 500 characters with a clear error.
evals.expected_output: Adds a failure scenario with a stable code, a HandledError subclass in the prompt contract, the code in app-codes.ts and copy in presentation.ts, the check in the service (not the transport), and a unit test asserting the code, not the message.

evals.prompt: modules/trace/server/src/services/redaction.service.ts contains PII stripping that belongs to data-privacy. Move it.
evals.expected_output: Moves the pure stripper into data-privacy contract (or server service if it needs runtime), repoints every importer including tests and vi.mock paths, adds no re-export, deletes the source, updates package.json dependencies and runs pnpm install, and runs tsc on every consumer to catch TS2304.

evals.prompt: apps/ui/src/features/prompts/ui/blocks/VariableChip.tsx is a generic prompt component; it should live in the prompt web package.
evals.expected_output: Moves it to modules/prompt/web/src/ui/elements or blocks with a kebab filename, keeps the layer direction, exposes it only through a surface or screen if apps/ui still needs it, repoints imports, and checks the install registries and screen closure.

evals.prompt: The dataset package has a REST app but hitting /api/v1/datasets returns 404 on the api process.
evals.expected_output: Finds that the dataset REST declaration is never mounted, adds the <f>-rest.mount.ts over the composed app using createRestRuntime (never the deleted security.createServiceVersionedApp / mountProjectTransport builders), registers the family from the API root only when the module is installed, adds or extends the composition test, and does not regenerate the OpenAPI document.

evals.prompt: Install the annotation-queue screen from @langwatch/annotation-web into apps/ui at /:project/annotations/queue.
evals.expected_output: Adds the catalogue.json use, the private apps/ui module folder with a host implementing the HostPort and a routes file built with uiPage, the WebInstallation in installed-ui-features, the pinned page key, feature-map.json, and runs the install guard tests.

evals.prompt: Make the worker run the new dataset-normalization command.
evals.expected_output: Installs the dataset server in the capability root that owns the job with .withModule, adds the catalogue entry, and calls out the job-registry.json change as deliberate; proves routability with the capability-mount test.
